title: Prove the arbitrary four-term literal triple-reader floor
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp actual-reader tariff floor for every at-most-four-term replacement of three literal PR3370 indicators, over every coefficient field and with arbitrary ambient factors. This closes arbitrary query dictionaries beyond PR3527's fixed rays.

```text
rank(U)+rank(Q) <= 7
  rank-three side: seven-point classification
    representable types: support transfer
    non-Fano: two binary maps + inherited VVV + new dense MMM floor
```

The new dense family has minimum excess at least two on all 4,960 triples. The original three terms attain the overall floor. Proof premises and runtime inputs are pinned to canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; predecessor packages remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3527 covers four fixed query rays. After: four marked-triple orbits cover every arbitrary four-term query configuration, with independent target gauges accounted for.
- New primary: 800 plane classes and 1,689,280 assignments. Separate raw-Gram replay: all 4,960 triples and 10,129,664 assignments. Both agree on the complete minimum stream, SHA256 `8c1512ea43fe447d843754b40e16e14fb0cb8ae64b85c249c2fc4c42cca09ce2`.
- All 96 candidate selective-span requests, 2,816 inherited template ranks, 12,544 gauged operator entries, 416 finite-field entries and four rejecting CLI mutations pass. The registered replay also reruns the inherited 185,031,864-state VVV primary.
- Final-head registered CPython 3.12 replay, committed Git-free direct commands, metadata/source-history checks and Ruff diagnostics pass. Exact replay commands, scope and credit are in `research/p112-four-term-query-classification/README.md` and `PROOF.md`.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19011230.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

This is a source-specific computer-assisted obstruction. Five terms, other partitions, physical consumers and complete supplier invoices remain open. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
